features: 【Bluetooth Connection】With Bluetooth connection for mobile devices such as tablets and mobile phones, you can pair the keyboard with your device at any time, bringing you more typing convenience. The Bluetooth keyboard has an operating range of up to 10 meters, making it ideal for use during travel, meetings or other mobile scenarios.

【Sensitive Touchpad & Scissor Switch】Sensitive touchpad supports left and right mouse button functions, allowing you to control your device without using a mouse. Multi-touch and enhanced gestures for easier operation. Quiet and responsive scissor switch's low-profile keys provide smooth, efficient, laptop-like input that eliminates over 90% of distracting sounds.

【USB Charging & Energy Saving Function】-The battery of the foldable keyboard has a capacity of 140 mAh and can be charged by a USB cable (Type-C charging cable included). With one charge, the uninterrupted working time is 48 hours and the standby time is about 3 months. Auto sleep power saving function, the keyboard will enter into auto sleep state after 15 minutes of inactivity.

【Triptych & Compact Portable Keyboard】-The foldable Bluetooth keyboard is made of aluminum alloy, it is lightweight and durable, so you don't have to worry about daily wear and tear. Open size is 11.97''x3.86''x0.31'', folded size is 6''x3.86''x0.55''. It can be easily put in pocket, purse or backpack, which is convenient for you anytime and anywhere. Ideal for office, travel and business trips.

【High Compatibility & Multi-Device Connectivity】-Our compact Bluetooth keyboard can connect up to 3 mobile devices at the same time. Switch easily with the touch of a button. Compatible with Windows, Mac OS, iOS or Android devices, you can easily work with your iPad, mobile phone, tablet or laptop.
